lines: On the count of one, two, three we step onto the go line
We still know nothing at all
When we cross the line and look back, it’s already gone
We still know nothing at all
It keeps shaking, shaking, shaking
Glittering sweat spills out
There must have been many things we don’t remember
Everyone is just a silhouette
We pretended to forget the things we cherished
There’s nothing there, we can laugh
On the count of one, two, three I recall the boy
We wanted everything
We know it, yes, we’re aware of it
The clock’s hands never stop each day
It snatches, it snatches, it snatches
Flowing time and memory
Stretching farther, farther, farther away
There must have been many things we don’t remember
Everyone is just a silhouette
We pretended not to know the things we feared
There’s nothing there, we can laugh
We flutter, we flutter, dancing lightly
Like leaves we want to live without sorrow or anxiety
There were many things we don’t remember
But surely something never changes
You, who taught me that, remain an undying silhouette
We’ll become adults holding what we value
We’ll keep protecting it, never letting go
Then someday
We’ll be able to laugh at everything
We flutter, we flutter, dancing lightly
Leaves drift away
